text:
marissa: Quick ping on Elmbridge preview intake — they enrolled 12 seats but only 4 active users so far. Concerned about pilot engagement and renewal risk. Can we push a tailored enablement session and send a short feedback micro-survey?
aj: noted. Do we have their onboarding playbook link?
katie: I have the playbook and can run enablement next Tue 10am PT. Who can present the advanced prompt tuning part?
sam: I can do a 20m deep-dive on prompt templates + output evals. Will prepare 3 examples.
marissa: thanks. Also Elmbridge reported inference errors during batch upload — they saw 502s at ~10:12am on Monday. @onboard-bot did we get logs?
onboard-bot: Elmbridge upload job failed: 502 from inference-gateway at 2025-11-03T10:12:18Z. Error ID: egw-7f3a. Link: https://redwood.internal/egw/egw-7f3a (internal)
aj: ops FYI — Sam, can you include troubleshooting notes and a remediation checklist?
sam: yes, will add a short troubleshooting cell to the playbook and share a gist.
katie: For the micro-survey I propose 3 questions: 1) primary use case 2) blockers encountered 3) likelihood to recommend. Short and to the point.
marissa: perfect. Also want to do a canary regen to see if errors were transient. Can EngInfra check routing config?
aj: filing a quick infra ticket, #eng-infra pinged. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4321
marissa: great. Can we target next Tue for enablement and send the survey Monday morning?
katie: yes — I'll send the invite today and the survey Monday AM.
sam: prep done, will post gist link in this thread by EOD.
marissa: awesome — assigning follow-ups: katie -> invites + survey, sam -> playbook + gist, aj -> infra ticket follow-through. Will run a brief 15m sync on Mon 9am PT if needed. :thumbsup:
aj: ack.
katie: ack.
sam: ack.
onboard-bot: Reminder: Elmbridge cohort seat usage threshold breached (inactive seats >50%) — automated nudges scheduled.
marissa: thanks, keep me posted. If we don't see uptake after enablement may move renewal to "at-risk" and propose extended pilot.
